content.what_it_is: MATLAB script (Mase-Kirby benchmark, fft/ directory) that converts a measured surface-elevation time series into wave components (period, amplitude, phase) for the FUNWAVE WK_TIME-type wavemaker (header comment L1). Inputs (L4-11): r2d470.dat (L5), truncated to 14336 samples ('14*1024' L6), sample_frequency=0.05 (L7, used as the sampling interval in t=[0:N-1]*sample_frequency L16), band-pass low_cutoff_freq=0.2 / high_cutoff_freq=10 (L8-9), scale_fac=0.01 (L10), output_file='wavemk_per_amp_pha.txt' (L11). Computes FFT d=fft(wave) (L17), M=floor((m+1)/2) (L19), record length time=sample_frequency*length(wave) (L20), Fourier coefficients a0=d(1)/m, an=2*real(d(2:M))/m, bn=-2*imag(d(2:M))/m (L21-23). Reconstructs the DFT interpolant y over x grid (L26, L31-36: y(i)=sum an(j)*cos(2*pi*j*x/time)+bn(j)*sin(...) plus a0). Amplitudes cn=sqrt(an^2+bn^2) and phases en=atan2(bn,an) (L38-41). Band-pass selection loop (L43-52): keeps components with ff=j/time in (low,high), storing per(icount)=time/j, cnn, enn. Rebuilds approximated series z from kept components z(i)=sum cnn(j)*cos(2*pi*x(i)/per(j)-enn(j))+a0 (L54-60). Plots data vs DFT interpolant vs approximation (L69-75). Writes output: fopen (L78), amplitudes scaled cnn=cnn*scale_fac (L80), fprintf '%12.8f %12.8f %12.8f' per/cnn/enn rows (L82-84), fclose (L85). No functions; script only.
entities: script variables: data1 @L5, data @L6, sample_frequency @L7, low_cutoff_freq @L8, high_cutoff_freq @L9, scale_fac @L10, output_file @L11, nr,nc @L14, wave @L15, t @L16, d @L17, m @L18, M @L19, time @L20, a0 @L21, an @L22, bn @L23, n @L25, x @L26, y @L29, cn @L39, en @L40, icount @L43, ff @L45, per @L48, cnn @L49, enn @L50, z @L54, fid @L78
calls: clear all @L3; load @L5; size @L14; fft @L17; floor @L19; zeros @L29, @L54; sqrt @L39; atan2 @L40; clf @L69; plot @L70, @L72, @L74; legend @L75; fopen @L78; fprintf @L83; fclose @L85

verbatim_spans.text: % This is script to make wave components (amplitude and phase) for given time series.

unresolved: sample_frequency=0.05 (L7) is used as the sampling interval dt (L16, L20), not a frequency -- variable name contradicts usage; actual sampling rate is 20 Hz.
scale_fac=0.01 (L10, applied L80) rescales output amplitudes; whether it converts cm to m for r2d470.dat is not stated in the file.

L6 truncates to exactly 14336 samples for FFT convenience ('14*1024') and assumes data1 is a single-column series; the load comment (L5) allows two columns but the truncation data1(1:14336) linear-indexes, which would interleave columns for two-column input; relation L5 vs L6 vs L14-15.
L13 comment 'start to run' ends with a non-ASCII replacement character (encoding artifact).
The commented fprintf of cutoff_number (L81) references a variable never defined; output consumer format (FUNWAVE WaveCompFile) is external to this file.
